subject: P95/P99 first-packet delays — BrightCommerce production
messages:
From: Tim Henderson <tim.henderson@brightcommerce.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@brightcommerce.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Rapid p95/p99 regressions — production timeouts (BrightCommerce)

Rishi,

We started seeing a big spike in request latency to the Redwood Hosted API at ~08:50 PDT. P95 jumped from ~320ms to ~1.2s and p99 is hovering around 2.6–3s for text-generation (short prompts). This is causing checkout latency spikes — customers are timing out.

Attached: brightcommerce_client_trace.har and a short p99 chart. We traced a few requests from our side and see a ~1.6s delay during TCP/TLS handshake before the first bytes from the model arrive.

Can you confirm whether this is an upstream network/CDN issue? Our engagement team is standing by — this is high impact for us. If you need additional traces or timestamps I can paste them.

—Tim
Tim Henderson
Sr. Platform Engineer, BrightCommerce
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Tim Henderson <tim.henderson@brightcommerce.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 09:28:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Rapid p95/p99 regressions — production timeouts (BrightCommerce)

Thanks Tim — we see the same regression in our per-customer p95/p99 dashboards for BrightCommerce. I'm escalating to infra and SRE and will keep you updated every 30 minutes until we have a mitigation.

Requests / asks from your side:
- If possible, paste 2 full request timestamps (client send) + request IDs from the traces — that helps correlate our ingress logs.
- Any specific regions where you see this (us-west, us-east)?

Plan: looping in Grace (infra) and Vivek (SRE) to triage TTL, CDN edge health, and upstream TLS behavior. Marissa from CS will coordinate updates with your account team.

We'll follow up with an initial hypothesis in the next 20–30 minutes.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Henderson <tim.henderson@brightcommerce.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 09:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Rapid p95/p99 regressions — production timeouts (BrightCommerce)

Quick triage notes (initial):
- Correlated BrightCommerce request IDs with ingress logs — we observe a pronounced spike in "time_to_first_byte" starting at 08:48 PDT lasting ~22 minutes, then intermittent afterwards.
- Traces show ~1.0–1.8s added before application data flow. TCP handshake RTTs to the CDN edge are normal (~25–40ms). The bulk of delay appears during TLS handshake between CDN edge and our upstream origin (us-west-2) — SNI routing appears to be retried and we see repeated TLS ClientHello timeouts.
- CDN provider (edge) is returning 502 for a subset of requests during the window, but origin logs show the upstream accepted the TCP connections — the delay is between edge->origin TLS negotiations.

Immediate mitigations I recommend:
1) Enable a temporary routing fallback for BrightCommerce traffic to the alternate origin pool (us-east-1) for the next 30 minutes. This will route around the affected edge->origin paths.
2) Increase keepalive time on the upstream side to reduce renegotiation frequency while we investigate.
3) SRE to open an edge incident with CDN provider (we've pulled tcpdump snippets).

I've attached an aggregated p99 trend and a small tcpdump excerpt (edge-to-origin-tcp-dump.txt). Vivek — can you kick off the routing change and coordinate the CDN provider contact?

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Inference Infrastructure
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Henderson <tim.henderson@brightcommerce.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 10:12:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Rapid p95/p99 regressions — production timeouts (BrightCommerce)

On it. Actions taken: 
- Flipped routing for BrightCommerce to alternate origin pool (us-east-1) at 10:05 PDT. Early checks show p95 dropped from ~1.2s to ~380ms within two minutes for the sampled requests.
- Opened Prod incident with CDN provider (ticket CDN-84211) and shared tcpdump + ClientHello timeouts.
- Temporarily increased upstream keepalive and disabled TLS renegotiation for the affected frontends.

Next steps:
- Work with CDN provider to identify root cause (their initial feedback: an edge rollout had a flaky TLS proxy for a small subset of POPs).
- Plan a controlled rollback if they confirm a bad rollout; maintain routing fallback for BrightCommerce until provider confirms full remediation.
- I'll run a 1-hour post-mitigation monitor and share graphs.

Marissa — can you confirm the customer saw the improvement and whether they need any billing goodwill?

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
SRE Lead
From: Tim Henderson <tim.henderson@brightcommerce.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 10:24:50 -0700
Subject: Re: Rapid p95/p99 regressions — production timeouts (BrightCommerce)

Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick turnaround — we see latency improve in our synthetic checks shortly after 10:06 PDT. p99 is back down to ~620ms and p95 at ~350ms in our region. Appreciate the routing workaround.

We will want to discuss a partial credit for the minutes impacted; please advise next steps for requesting that from billing and whether there's a post-incident RCA we can share with our security/compliance team.

—Tim
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Tim Henderson <tim.henderson@brightcommerce.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 18:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rapid p95/p99 regressions — production timeouts (BrightCommerce)

Tim — glad to hear you saw improvement. Follow-ups: 
- Marissa will open a billing goodwill request and we'll loop in finance to evaluate a partial credit; I'll include the impacted window and metrics.
- Grace & Vivek will produce a short RCA (root cause: CDN edge TLS proxy rollout causing intermittent ClientHello timeouts that added ~1s to TTFT; mitigation: routing fallback + CDN rollback; long-term: provider to patch rollout and we will add multi-origin health checks). Expect the RCA by end of day tomorrow.
- We'll share the security/compliance summary for your team (redacted logs + timeline) along with the RCA.

Marissa — please start the billing request (HS-78921) and let Tim know the expected timeline. I'll also prepare an exec note for our leadership.

Thanks everyone for the quick coordination.

—Rishi
